method: Remove live ADB reverse mapping; desktop monitor restores it without a USB button press. Restart phone app to require a new authenticated session.
transport_reset_limit: The explicit adb reconnect command left the host ADB transport absent while the USB device remained enumerated. Restarting the audit-owned ADB server restored device visibility. This is not a passed physical unplug/replug test.
physical_cable_unplug_evidence: User confirmed on 2026-10-30 that both updated apps reconnect automatically after unplug/replug.
